body: Hey, can you tell where did you see the syntax of passing array of array for the labels field?

Passing array to a label to make it multiline is a well-known receipt suggested by stackoverflow community.

Are you saying this is not declared feature? I count it so natural and surprised not finding it in official documentation... The only place I found is [Title Configuration](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/configuration/title.html#title-configuration) (and Subtitle too), but actually it works for any labels — for dataset, for ticks, etc (see an example below).

The case with "extremely long labels" — https://codepen.io/cellard/pen/xxWYEvX — seems much harder to solve (

It is indeed intentional behaviour. Explanation can be found in the docs here: https://www.chartjs.org/docs/master/general/data-structures.html#data-structures

> In case you want multiline labels you can provide an array with each line as one entry in the array

issue.body:
### Expected behavior

It is unacceptable that changing the legend position from "top" to "left" or "right" in Chart.js using Angular v4.x.x results in runtime errors when chart options are null. This issue needs to be addressed and resolved immediately.


### Current behavior

When changing the legend position from "top" to "left" or "right" in Chart.js starting from `v4.x.x`  using Angular. it causes runtime errors whereas chart options are `null` for no reason. Which should be working as usual. ,
